pol-sec-01-c1.text: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy. Kant's Social and Political Philosophy. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
pol-sec-01-c1.quote: The first of these is that every state shall have a republican civil constitution.
pol-sec-01-c1.claim: In Perpetual Peace (1795), Immanuel Kant identified the conditions for a durable peace: republican government, a federation of free states, and cosmopolitan right.

pol-sec-01-c2.text: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy. War. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
pol-sec-01-c2.quote: reflection on the resort to war—jus ad bellum—and conduct in war—jus in bello.
pol-sec-01-c2.claim: The tradition separates jus ad bellum, the criteria for when war is justified, from jus in bello, the criteria for how war must be conducted.
